outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and closes its gripper around the upper drawer handle in frames 20–80 (left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward in frames 90–104 (image and left_ego_image). The extended drawer and exposed side are clearly visible in frames 130–170 (image and left_ego_image); the gripper releases and withdraws in frames 134–170 (wrist_image). The drawer remains open, with no observed failed attempt or robot-caused side effect.
